summary:
I fixed 29 of the 30 r1_fixB findings at the root and skipped 1, which is in a file the battle fixer owns. Node suite: `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n` passes 635/0 (48 files), and no ⟦missing⟧ keys are left except the suite's own test key `nao.existe.x`. QA scripts, all passing: new qa/persona_r1_shell.mjs 85/85, screens_check 49/49, base_ui_check 90/90, dogfight_check 44/44, geo_check 37/37, campaign_flow_check 127/127, ui_wave4_check 74/74, and full_campaign ran once with no errors. I looked at the screenshots at 1440×900, 1024×576 and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834 touch; they are in scratchpad/ui4/persona_r1_shell.

Per finding:
- #0, #10 Estimated crew size in the briefings now uses the mission month (`deploymentRange(id, diff, month)`). A Node test checks the source so no call drops the month again — FIXED.
- #1 (critical), #3, #24 The lost-Skyranger dead end is now a guided path that can always be recovered — FIXED:
  - When hired soldiers or a new Skyranger arrive, fit soldiers with no craft board a transport that has seats, and anyone without a weapon is equipped from stores (research, ammo and Strength are respected).
  - Arriving weapons re-equip soldiers still unarmed aboard.
  - The delivery popup says who boarded and who is still unarmed, with a «Kit básico» button: confirm the cost, then rifles, clips and grenades are bought through BaseSim.
  - The «Nave perdida» popup also tells the player to buy weapons.
  - «Enviar equipa» explains why a transport has no troops and offers a one-click fix: «Embarcar N e equipar», «Equipar automaticamente», «Kit básico» or the Pessoal tab.
  - The «Equipa no local» popup and the briefing warn «N soldados vão SEM ARMA»; the briefing has an «Equipar automaticamente» button (A).
  - Base → Naves has «Embarcar aptos (n)» (A) plus an unarmed warning, and the Pessoal tab explains all this.
  - «Ir para a base» after scientists arrive opens Investigação (engineers go to Produção).
- #2 Saves — FIXED:
  - Two rotating autosaves: the previous `auto` becomes «Automática (anterior)».
  - A «Antes da missão» save is written when the briefing opens and is never overwritten by a post-defeat state.
  - After a defeat or abort on Recruta/Veterano, the mission report offers «Repetir a missão» (R): it loads that save and reopens the same briefing.
  - The save dialog lists, loads, exports and deletes both extra slots.
- #4 The UFO type is consistent across screens — FIXED:
  - The type is known if hyper-wave identified it, it was seen in a battle, or a briefing showed it.
  - Until then the UFO shows «Eco <tamanho>», and the size row is labelled «Eco de radar».
- #5 Deliveries arriving together are summed («Chegaram 10 soldados») — FIXED.
- #6 Defeat reports explain the cause — FIXED:
  - Deaths are counted by cause from `killedBy`/`deathCause`: friendly fire (including own explosives), enemy, wounds.
  - The report header shows «N soldados mortos por fogo amigo» and a one-sentence tip for the main cause.
- #7 Double-click on «Começar» no longer skips the briefing (second click with `detail > 1` is ignored). The Esc menu over the Battlescape now shows the mission objective — FIXED.
- #8 SKIPPED: the overflowing menu is in css/battle.css, owned by the battle fixer. Patch is in open_issues.
- #9 Dogfight against a very small UFO with missiles on: the fight pauses and asks «Desligar mísseis?» (Q/Enter switches them off, N/Esc keeps them). After two «Manter» answers in a campaign it stops asking — FIXED.
- #11 Focus is trapped (rest of the page inert, focus returned on close) in: OV.Dom.modal, base sheets, the base Equipar overlay, Opções, Gravações, the monthly report, and Geoscape popups and dialogs — FIXED. Enter on «Cancelar» no longer confirms the modal.
- #12 Soldados list is keyboard-selectable (↑/↓/Home/End, Enter to the name field); the facility grid has a keyboard cursor (arrows, Enter selects, ⌫ dismantles) — FIXED.
- #13 Geoscape shortcut badges stay visible down to 1024 px (hidden only on touch). Tab now moves through the panel buttons; target cycling moved to T/⇧T — FIXED.
- #14 Base placement and the Geoscape destination mode work by keyboard: arrows turn the globe under a centre crosshair; Space (placement) or Enter/Space (destination) picks the point — FIXED.
- #15 Difficulty cards: keyboard focus follows the selection (roving focus) — FIXED.
- #16 Keyboard focus survives re-renders in the base (found again by its data-* key) and in the save list — FIXED.
- #17 Enter on the Quick Battle report continues even when the scrolling body has focus — FIXED.
- #18 A Ufopédia search with no results goes back to the article open before the search — FIXED.
- #19 Base buttons have contextual accessible names («Iniciar: Armas Laser», «Menos Stingray»…); buttons disabled with a reason are no longer Tab stops — FIXED.
- #20 New «Acessibilidade» section in Opções (palette, keyboard cursor, reduce motion, text size); defaults in main.js; `<html>` attributes and `--ui-scale` on :root — FIXED.
  - The colour-blind palette tokens, reduce motion and text size apply to all strategy screens, modals and toasts.
- #21 `--dim` raised to 5.0:1; empty-list text uses `--muted` — FIXED.
- #22 After losing the craft, the report title uses the craft's real base, or «Material da missão» — FIXED.
- #23 iPad texts no longer name keys (intro, next steps, «Nave perdida», destination hint, briefing hint); the menu key hint is hidden on touch; «Como jogar» shows the «Toque» section first on touch — FIXED.
- #25 «1–1» now reads «1 alienígena» — FIXED.
- #26 Enter/«Ir» in the base-name field only closes the keyboard (a second Enter founds the base) — FIXED.
- #27 Quick Battle — FIXED:
  - The heavy weapon goes to the strongest soldiers.
  - The briefing has an «Equipar» step via `OV.InventoryUI.equipScreen`.
  - A month-based store (smoke always, stun rod from month 1, small launcher + stun bombs from month 3) is what is left on the Skyranger floor.
- #28 At night one flare goes on the belt and one in the pack — FIXED.
- #29 Terror-site stakes and the monthly-report advice show the real penalty (500 in months 0–1) — FIXED.

Two behaviour changes the others should know about:
- A popup or dialog on the Geoscape now makes the side panel inert for the mouse too. I changed qa/full_campaign.mjs (do not click the speed buttons while a popup is open) and qa/dogfight_check.mjs (missile question turned off for its scenarios) to match.
- The research picker now opens by itself only when the player asks for a new project or none is running, so arriving scientists land on the project list.
deviations: The extra save slots ('auto2', 'preMission') are a UI-only fallback. js/sim/save.js is not my file and the sim fixer is editing it, so campaign_ui writes these slots straight to localStorage under OV.Save.KEY(slot), in the same JSON format, and reads them back with OV.Save.importFile. The exact sim patch is in open_issues.

Auto-equip is a UI-side function (OV.CampaignUI.autoKit) that only changes G through Campaign.equipPool/applyEquip. inventory_ui's internal autoFor is not exported and is owned by the battle fixer. My version never picks unresearched items, needs ammo for the gun, respects the soldier's Strength, and puts one medikit in the team.
Geoscape target cycling moved from Tab to T/⇧T so that Tab moves through the panel buttons (finding #13). The «Como jogar» Geoscape table has a new row for it.

Geoscape popups and dialogs now make the side panel and the other layers inert (focus trap); only the globe canvas stays live. Clicking the panel while a popup is open does nothing until the popup is closed. qa/full_campaign.mjs was updated to match.

BaseUI.open gained a 4th argument {pick}. The research picker opens automatically only with pick:true (from «Novo projeto» and the report's «Investigação» button) or when no project is running. «Ir para a base» after new scientists therefore shows the project list so they can be assigned.

Text scale uses CSS `zoom: var(--ui-scale)` on my scene roots (.scr, which also covers the base screen and the Ufopédia; .geo; .df-root) and on #modals .modal, #toasts and #tooltip. Checked in Chromium at 130 %: everything fits and the panels scroll. The battle HUD scales itself (battle fixer).

The 'reduce motion' setting adds a global CSS rule in base.css (:root[data-motion=reduce] stops animations and transitions on every screen), so the Battlescape CSS gets it too. The JS checks in screens, geo, dogfight and Ufopédia now go through OV.Game.reduceMotion().
qa/dogfight_check.mjs sets G.ui.dfMissileKeep = 2 in its scenarios so the new missile question does not block them; the question itself is tested in qa/persona_r1_shell.mjs.
open_issues: css/battle.css (battle fixer), finding #8: make the menu grow to its content, e.g. `.bs-menu-list { width: max-content; min-width: 100%; }` and `.bs-mi-acc { padding-right: 2px; }`. Alternatively use `white-space: nowrap` on the «Prec. NN %» cell with no thin space before «%».

js/ui/inventory_ui.js (battle fixer), finding #1(d): when «Auto-equipar» finds no usable firearm with ammo, show a toast. Suggested key 'hud.equip.noWeapons' = «Armazém sem armas com munição — compre espingardas e carregadores no Mercado (base → 8).» The footer hint 'hud.equip.hint' also needs a touch variant («Toque no objeto e depois no destino»), finding #23.

js/sim/save.js (sim owner), optional patch so the extra slots go through OV.Save: `const SLOTS = ['auto', 'auto2', 'preMission', 'autoTurn', '1', '2', '3'];` (validSlot/list follow automatically). After that, campaign_ui.extraKey/readExtra can switch to OV.Save.read/write/remove; the stored format is identical.

Battle fixer: the shared accessibility settings live in OV.Game.settings {palette, kbCursor, reduceMotion, textScale}. <html> gets data-palette='normal|cvd' and data-motion='reduce|full', and :root gets --ui-scale. OV.Game.reduceMotion() returns the effective boolean. In tests OV.Game can be missing, so default safely.
DESIGN §15.5 lists Geoscape Tab as 'next UFO'. It is now T/⇧T (Tab moves through the panel buttons). Please update the doc if it is meant to stay in sync.

Balance note (sim): with the missiles switched off, a Small Scout escaped the cannon-only Interceptor within about 30 dogfight ticks in a Node probe. The new question makes the trade-off explicit, but whether the cannon alone can reliably bring down very small UFOs is for the sim/data owner to tune.
